name: import-ca
description: Private CA certificates for the trust store, as many as you like: PEM text and URLs (optionally pinned by SHA-256 fingerprint) at build time, and whatever *.crt files are in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates at each start — mount the project's there.

certs.description: PEM certificates to trust at build time, concatenated (a bundle holds any number).

urls.description: URLs serving PEM certificates, fetched at build time, separated by whitespace. `url#fingerprint[,fingerprint...]` pins what the URL may return by SHA-256 fingerprint and skips TLS verification for that fetch; a URL without a fingerprint is fetched with normal verification.
